transcript: This recorded notice was shared this morning. This is a weather update for the area around the science room. Heavy rain is expected after eleven twenty. Outdoor practice will end early, and the river path will close for the evening. Students walking home should use the station road, not the lower bridge. Families will receive another message if the warning changes.
